channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Why a token chart can have gaps in its history
item.description: A gap in a token chart can mean no trades, missing data, or a change in the market being tracked; check the source before comparing prices or judging its history.

item.title: Solana begins public test of Alpenglow finality upgrade
item.description: Solana has activated Alpenglow on its public testnet, where validators will test a consensus change targeting 150-millisecond finality and faster payment certainty.
